comments.body: Hi, thank you fo rthe contribution, good catch!

If we are going to add a test, I'd rather have it test all the values that are computed 
in this `try` / `except` bloc instead of just this case. That way we have test on all the
value based on the previous snapshot instead only the commit ratio.

What do you think? Would  that be ok for you to add this?

Sure, makes sense. I extended the tests to cover everything computed in that `try` block from the previous snapshot: `tps`, `size_evolution`, inserts/updates/deletes per second, cache hit ratio and rollback ratio, plus a case with no activity between the two snapshots (no ratio computed). The server snapshots are faked by patching `pg.fetchone`, so no PostgreSQL instance is needed. Pushed as a new commit on top.

This reply was drafted with the help of an AI assistant (Claude); the change and tests were reviewed before posting.
